question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who does not eat any animal product
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 **i.e. **Vegan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A person who does not eat any animal product is referred to as a **vegan**. This includes meat, dairy, and all other animal-derived substances. शुद्ध शाकाहारी

 
 
• **Example:** Many vegans also avoid products that are tested on animals or made from animal skins.
 
 
 
• **Veganism **is not just about diet but also about lifestyle choices that seek to exclude, as far as possible, all forms of exploitation of, and cruelty to, animals for food, clothing, or any other purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** She switched to a vegan diet for health reasons and soon found it also aligned with her ethical beliefs.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Vegan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vegetarian:** A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons. In Hindi, it can be translated as शाकाहारी .

 
 
• **Example**: Vegetarians often have to check if food products contain any hidden animal products. In Hindi, it can be translated as सब्ज़ी.
 
 
 
• **Veggie:** This is a more casual term used to refer to vegetables or sometimes vegetarian meals or diets. 
 
 
• **Example**: She loves cooking and always comes up with the most delicious veggie recipes.
 
 
 
• **Non-vegetarian:** This term is used to describe someone who includes meat and other animal products in their diet. In Hindi, non-vegetarian is मांसाहारी .
 
 
• **Example**: Non-vegetarian food items include chicken, fish, and beef, among others.
